recommendations.text: Clinical probability assessment should guide diagnostic strategy
For PE Assessment, the following actions are mandatory: - assess vital signs (within 10 minutes) - assess wells score - order lab d dimer
Massive PE with hemodynamic instability requires systemic thrombolysis. [REQUIRED: give_thrombolytic, give_alteplase_pe] (Severity: CRITICAL)

Massive PE with shock requires thrombolysis; anticoagulation alone has unacceptably high mortality (25-65%). [FORBIDDEN: give_anticoagulation_only_in_massive_pe, delay_thrombolysis_in_massive_pe] (Severity: CRITICAL)
recommendations.source_guideline: ESC PE 2019; massive PE with hemodynamic collapse requires thrombolysis; anticoagulation alone has 25-65% mortality

recommendations.text: Heparin in HIT causes catastrophic thrombosis. [FORBIDDEN: give_heparin, give_enoxaparin, give_ufh] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Standard DOAC dosing in morbid obesity may be subtherapeutic. [FORBIDDEN: give_standard_dose_doac, give_rivaroxaban_standard] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: ISTH 2021; Martin KA, J Thromb Haemost 2021

recommendations.text: Warfarin and DOACs are teratogenic. LMWH is safe in pregnancy. [FORBIDDEN: give_warfarin, give_doac] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Enoxaparin accumulates in severe renal impairment. Dose adjustment required. [FORBIDDEN: give_enoxaparin_full_dose] (Severity: HIGH)
Active bleeding is absolute contraindication to thrombolysis. [FORBIDDEN: give_thrombolysis, give_alteplase_pe, give_full_dose_anticoagulation] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Pregnancy PE: prefer V/Q scan over CT-PA; warfarin/DOACs teratogenic. [FORBIDDEN: order_ct_pa_without_considering_vq, give_warfarin, give_doac] (Severity: HIGH)
Morbid obesity >150kg: DOAC pharmacokinetics unreliable, use LMWH or UFH. [FORBIDDEN: give_standard_dose_doac, give_apixaban_standard, give_rivaroxaban_standard] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: ISTH 2021; Martin KA, J Thromb Haemost 2021

recommendations.text: Recent surgery within 3 weeks is relative contraindication to thrombolysis. [FORBIDDEN: give_thrombolysis, give_alteplase_pe] (Severity: HIGH)
Anticoagulation should be initiated without delay when clinical probability is high
For Confirmed PE - Hemodynamically Stable, the following actions are mandatory: - give anticoagulation (within 60 minutes) - order imaging ct pa - order lab troponin - order lab bnp
During Confirmed PE - Hemodynamically Stable, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: delay anticoagulation if high probability.
Systemic thrombolysis is recommended for patients with massive PE and hemodynamic instability
For Massive PE - Hemodynamically Unstable, the following actions are mandatory: - give anticoagulation (within 30 minutes) - give thrombolysis (within 60 minutes)
During Massive PE - Hemodynamically Unstable, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: delay anticoagulation.
